# Results digest (auto-generated by `run_study.py report`)

Narrative and interpretation: see `REPORT.md`.

## Paper vs this study

| Aspect | Metry et al. (paper) | This study |
|---|---|---|
| Data | 1 electrical panel, Fluke 935 logger, ~50 days, 70,621 samples | 1,332 telecom sites, daily rectifier KPIs, 524 days, 669,893 observed site-days |
| Raw / selected features | 32 → 11 | 33 candidates → 11 |
| Forecast target | Active Power AN Avg (W) | Avg DC Load Power (kW, reported in W) |
| Forecast MAE | 61.12 W | 61.6 W |
| Forecast RMSE | 135.79 W | 117.8 W |
| Forecast MAPE | 0.97 % | 1.32 % |
| Forecast R² | 0.9668 | 0.9964 pooled / 0.640 median per site |
| Skill vs persistence | not reported | 0.287 |
| AE reconstruction MAE / MSE / RMSE / R² | 0.0264 / 0.0019 / 0.0432 / 0.9004 | 0.2677 / 0.4097 / 0.6400 / 0.8419 (site-relative z units) |
| AE threshold | 95th pct of KDE (training errors) | 95th pct of KDE (held-out validation errors) = 0.9739 |
| Anomalies flagged | 930 of 70,621 (1.32 %) | AE 8,301 (5.95%); OR 13,724 (9.84%); AND 1,549 (1.11%) of test site-days |
| Dominant root-cause indicators | THD A, THD V | conversion ratio, DC bus voltage, load swing, battery discharge (DC-plant supply quality) |
| Detection validated | no labels | fault injection (OR recall 84 %) and operational events (AND 32x enriched for mains outages) |

## Preprocessing log

| step | detail | rows_after |
|---|---|---|
| load | 3 export parts concatenated, 63 raw columns, 1,570 sites | 867,257 |
| parse dates | mixed-padding M/D/YYYY -> 2025-01-01 .. 2026-06-08 | 867,257 |
| drop exact duplicates | 152,345 repeated export rows removed | 714,912 |
| percent strings | '100%'-style text converted to numeric | 714,912 |
| column pruning | 25 columns dropped (all-empty, constant, or exact copies such as Site Fuel == DG Fuel); 36 kept | 714,912 |
| merge dual power systems | 3 sites with two rectifier systems aggregated per day | 714,414 |
| placeholder replacement | 4,120 implausible values set to NaN (physical limits, P/I consistency, NMS zero-placeholders) | 714,414 |
| feature engineering | derived DC bus voltage (P/I), conversion ratio (DC out/AC in), load swing ((Pmax-Pmin)/Pavg), DC/RAN energy ratio | 714,414 |
| calendar reindex | 524 days x 1,570 sites; 13.2% of site-days have no export | 822,680 |
| join weather | hourly regional weather -> daily mean/max temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, UV | 822,680 |
| join inventory events | 5,589 board power-on events inside the study window | 822,680 |
| site selection | 1,332 of 1,570 sites have >= 240 observed training days and >= 30 test days | 697,968 |
| missing-value handling | gaps <= 3 days linearly interpolated inside each site; longer gaps break sequences | 697,968 |

## Table I — correlation observations and feature selection

| Feature group | Observation (within-site r) | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| DC load power vs current (avg/max/min) | P vs I r=0.98; bus voltage is near-constant so P = V·I | Keep Avg DC Load Power as the target; drop currents (redundant). DC Load Energy = 24·P exactly → drop |
| Total energy input vs DC load | r=0.41; diverges from output on battery charge/discharge days | Not a forecasting input; used as the denominator of the conversion ratio (health indicator) |
| RAN board energy vs LTE / NR energy | RAN vs LTE r=0.45, vs NR r=0.73 | Keep the aggregate RAN Board Energy (independent NMS meter, r=0.65 with load); drop LTE/NR split |
| Traffic vs load | r=0.28 with load, 0.41 with RAN energy | Retain Traffic as the demand driver |
| Ambient temperature (avg/max), pressure, UV | avg vs max r=0.99; avg temp vs load r=0.44; pressure vs temp r=-0.92 | Keep Avg Ambient Temp (cooling-load driver); drop max/pressure (seasonal proxies) |
| Ambient humidity | r=-0.24 with load, -0.56 with temp | Retain: partly independent weather signal |
| Battery vs indoor temperature | r=0.83; indoor sensors cover only ~59 % of site-days | Keep Avg Battery Temp (thermal-stress indicator); drop indoor temp/humidity |
| Battery discharge vs mains outage / DG duration | vs DG hours r=-0.82, vs mains outage r=0.12 | Keep Battery Discharge (valid for every power configuration); outage, DG, LLVD kept as root-cause indicators |
| DC bus voltage | r=-0.43 with discharge, 0.08 with load | Retain: voltage-quality indicator, largely independent of load |
| Conversion ratio, load swing, DC/RAN ratio | max /r/ with other selected features: conv 0.11, swing 0.17, DC/RAN 0.35 | Retain all three for unique health characterisation (efficiency, load distortion, meter consistency) |
